title: Pre-registration for the TopoDB biology persistent-homology block
honesty_note: This file is committed ALONE, before any biological dataset is computed on.
Exception, stated plainly: the Step 0 known-answer rules below were written in the
docstring of step0_known_answer.py and that script was run BEFORE this file was
committed; its numbers are already known (circle 39.50, sine 174.17, random 1.04).
Everything else in this file is pre-stated: no biological persistence diagram has
been computed at the time of this commit.

seeds.note: the influenza subsample seed is inherited from the earlier genetics validation run so that the alignment files on disk are the ones the seed refers to

method_discipline.binding_rule_a: Never embed a non-Euclidean distance into 3-D and then run alpha. The earlier genetics validation produced a FALSE dominant H1 (dominance 11.1) that way on the tree-like influenza HA segment. Hi-C, scRNA correlation/cosine and sequence Hamming are computed with Rips on the given metric only; bio_common.py contains no MDS function.
method_discipline.binding_rule_b: Alpha is used only where coordinates are genuinely Euclidean (protein/RNA atoms in Angstrom).
method_discipline.gudhi_convention: create_simplex_tree(max_dimension = max_hom_dim + 1), because the d-skeleton yields homology only to d-1. Step 0 runs through the same helper, so a regression would show there as b1 = 0 on the circle.

step0_known_answer.A_noisy_circle_rips: dominance(H1) >= 5 AND exactly one H1 bar with persistence >= P1/2
step0_known_answer.gate: if any fails, the biology block stops and reports the failure

test_P_protein_fold_separation.question: Does any persistence statistic of the C-alpha point cloud separate all-alpha from all-beta proteins?
test_P_protein_fold_separation.data: ~30 protein chains fetched from https://files.rcsb.org/download/XXXX.pdb, plus the three verified-genuine local files 1CRN, 1UBQ, 4OBE

fold_class_rule.derived_from: the PDB header's own HELIX and SHEET records, counted by this pipeline; no CATH/SCOP lookup is required
fold_class_rule.helix_frac: residues covered by HELIX records / residues with a C-alpha in the chain
fold_class_rule.sheet_frac: residues covered by SHEET records / residues with a C-alpha in the chain
fold_class_rule.other: anything else; excluded from the separation test
fold_class_rule.note: if a structure has no HELIX/SHEET records at all it is classed 'unannotated' and excluded

primary_statistic.name: h1_small_bar_density
primary_statistic.definition: (number of H1 alpha-complex bars whose death radius < 4.5 A) / n_CA
primary_statistic.rationale: an alpha helix repeats its CA i->i+3/i+4 contacts every 5.4 A of pitch, so a helical chain produces many SMALL, short-lived H1 classes per residue; a beta barrel produces few small classes and one large one
primary_statistic.complex: alpha complex on the C-alpha coordinates, filtration reported as the plain radius (sqrt of the squared alpha value), Z/2 coefficients, max_hom_dim 2

secondary_statistics_prestated.name: h1_large_loop_max_pers
secondary_statistics_prestated.definition: max persistence among H1 bars with death radius >= 6.0 A, else 0

secondary_statistics_prestated.name: h1_dominance_P1_over_P2
secondary_statistics_prestated.direction: all-beta > all-alpha (a barrel should give one dominant loop)

null_and_controls.null: label permutation: 10000 random reassignments of the all-alpha / all-beta labels among the same structures, AUC recomputed each time; p = rank p on |AUC - 0.5|
null_and_controls.size_baseline_control: AUC computed from n_CA alone, on the same labels. This is the confound control: chain length correlates with fold class, and a label permutation does NOT protect against a size classifier.
null_and_controls.unbanded_control: AUC from (total H1 bar count)/n_CA, to show whether the scale band matters

test_P_protein_fold_separation.decision_rule: Separation is claimed ONLY IF all three hold: (i) AUC >= 0.75; (ii) permutation p <= 0.01; (iii) |AUC_primary - 0.5| > |AUC_size_baseline - 0.5|. If (iii) fails the honest verdict is 'does not separate beyond chain length'. Any other outcome is reported as inconclusive or null.
test_P_protein_fold_separation.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: unknown; the pipeline has never been run on protein folds here

test_R_rna.question: Do RNA backbone (P atom) point clouds differ in persistence from protein C-alpha clouds?
test_R_rna.prestated: no quantitative expectation; these are recorded for breadth and contrast, with statistics but no p-value (no null is defined)

test_H_hic_circular_vs_linear.question: Does Rips on the contact-derived metric give H1 = 1 for a circular bacterial chromosome and H1 = 0 for a linear human chromosome arm?
data: Caulobacter crescentus GSM1120445 (Le et al. 2013 Science)
E. coli GSM2870407 (Lioy et al. 2018 Cell)
human GM12878 chr1q 250 kb KR (Rao et al. 2014)
test_H_hic_circular_vs_linear.metric: d = C^(-1/3) on the ICE/iteratively-corrected contact matrix, Rips on that metric directly (NO MDS, per rule (a))

criteria.circular_positive: dominance >= 2 AND p <= 0.01 against the linear null
criteria.cut_control: cutting the circular chromosome at ter must reduce the dominance

test_H_hic_circular_vs_linear.null: linear null: random contact matrices generated from the observed distance-decay curve of the same dataset with no circular wrap, n = 200 (compute-limited; the earlier run used 500 for alpha / 50 for Rips)
test_H_hic_circular_vs_linear.prior_result_to_reproduce: the earlier validation reached alpha P1/P2 = 3.57 (p = 0.002) for E. coli and FAILED for Caulobacter (1.05). Failure to reproduce is reported as such.

test_F_influenza.question: Do single influenza segments (tree-like) give H1 ~ 0 while concatenated genomes (reassortment) give H1 > 0? (Chan, Carlsson & Rabadan 2013 PNAS)
test_F_influenza.data: alignments prepared by the earlier genetics validation run: influenza/work/aln_seg{1..8}.npy, 300 avian complete 8-segment genomes, subsample seed 20260919
test_F_influenza.metric: Hamming (p-distance) over aligned sites, Rips on that matrix directly (NO MDS, per rule (a))
primary_statistics: B = number of H1 bars with persistence >= 0.005
test_F_influenza.null: site bootstrap: resample alignment columns with replacement within each segment, n = 200

criteria.i: A_concatenated significant (p <= 0.01) against the pooled single-segment site-bootstrap null
criteria.ii: A for each single segment <= half A_concatenated

test_F_influenza.false_positive_guard: the alpha-on-MDS-3 route is NOT run; the earlier validation showed it gives dominance 11.1 on segment 4 (HA), which is a tree, i.e. a FALSE loop

test_C_cellcycle.question: Does Rips on the cell-cycle-gene correlation metric give a dominant H1 loop?
test_C_cellcycle.metric: cell-cell distance d = sqrt(2(1 - rho)) on Spearman correlation of z-scored cell-cycle genes; Rips on that metric directly
test_C_cellcycle.prior_result: the earlier validation FAILED both (alpha on PCA-3: P1/P2 = 1.53 and 1.61, gene-permutation p = 0.37 and 0.08) although the phase angle was recovered. This is a DIFFERENT pipeline (Rips on the correlation metric, full dimension), so it is a fair new run.
test_C_cellcycle.null: gene-wise permutation of the expression matrix, n = 200 (compute-limited), recomputing the metric and the diagram each time
test_C_cellcycle.negative_control: the same number of random non-cell-cycle expressed genes
test_C_cellcycle.commitment: no tuning. Whatever comes out of this pre-stated setting is the reported result; a second FAIL is the finding.

test_B_breadth_pbmc3k.question: none. pbmc3k is a breadth dataset: discrete immune cell types, no cell cycle worth speaking of and no loop expected.
test_B_breadth_pbmc3k.prestated: recorded with statistics and NO p-value, because no null is defined for 'we expect nothing in particular'

test_E_physionet_delay_embedding.question: Does a real periodic physiological signal give a dominant H1 loop under delay embedding? This is a real-data known-answer case: a heartbeat is periodic, so it MUST.

criteria.ii: a phase-randomised surrogate of the same signal gives a lower dominance

test_E_physionet_delay_embedding.null: phase-randomised (amplitude-adjusted Fourier transform) surrogates of the same recording, n = 200

synthetic_control_ingested_deliberately.reason: the local /mnt/disks/disk-socrateai-local-1/bio_datasets/*.npy arrays carry real-source labels but are SYNTHETIC (all 23 files written within 0.79 s; the contact map is an exactly monotone function of the coordinate distances, Spearman -1.0). One is ingested as a LABELLED synthetic control so the DB records why it must not be used as data.

tiers.X: every run in this block is tier X (numerics). Nothing here is tier A, B or L.
tiers.language: the words 'proved', 'certified' and 'guaranteed' do not appear in any finding.
